flagged.evidence: The title says “A non-diagonal filling lattice obstructs smooth sliceness,” while the Statement requires the stronger condition that Q_W have no isometric full-rank embedding into Z^n. The lattice with Gram matrix [[4,2],[2,5]], generated by (2,0) and (1,2) inside standard Z^2, is non-diagonalizable over Z but has such an embedding. Thus being non-diagonal alone does not license the obstruction named in the title.
